newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares up following U.S. indicators.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares up following U.S. indicators.

text.p: Norwegian shares firmed slightly with major European bourses on Thursday following the release of American CPI and retail figures.
Oslo's Total share index, after a weak opening, finished 0.27 percent higher at 935.56 points in turnover worth a moderate 712 million crowns.
"The bourse was given an extra boost after the CPI and retail figures poured in from the United States," one dealer said.
"If it had not been for the United States the index would have ended flat today," the dealer said.
U.S. consumer prices advanced moderately in November and total retail sales fell.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro was the most heavily traded stock at 61 million crowns, rising 0.76 percent to 330 crowns.
